purpose: Install a portable one-click F-disk runner recovery structure so the same single runner can be restarted after PC reboot, runner closure, or moving the disk to another Windows PC without creating a new runner/worktree topology.
required_runner_actions: make launchers drive-letter tolerant by deriving portable root from their own path
abort stale git rebase or merge states before pull
remove stale MULTI_PAGE runner lock folders
stash local runtime changes before pull so GitHub sync is one click
run the existing F portable single runner continuation script
